verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents spend coding at transaction level. Payments are claimed to appear already categorized by area, owner and expense type. Transactions can be classified by category, cost center and supplier, receipts and invoices can be linked to them, and transactions can be updated and reconciled. Cost-center and category analysis supports a review-style close. missing for 10: explicit memo/notes field on transactions, evidence of receipt capture at the moment of spend (e.g., mobile upload or auto-matching), detail on how automatic categorization works in real time, independent or hands-on corroboration.
